text: The Clean Air Investment Trust Ventures Inc. (CVI) is a wholly-owned subsidiary of Toronto Atmospheric Fund(TAF). Its Board of Directors is made up of at least three members of the TAF Board. Changes to the CVI Board membership are recommended given retirements from the TAF Board.

The Board of Directors of the Toronto Atmospheric Fund: 1. Removed Sandra Odendahl as a director of the Clean Air Investment Trust - CAIT Ventures Inc. Board of Directors. 2. Appointed Parminder Sandhu to the Clean Air Investment Trust - CAIT Ventures Inc.
